# Rule Catalog (generated)

<!-- Generated by `revoc-proxy list-rules`. Do not edit: a test fails if this page differs from the code. Regenerate with
     cargo run -p revoc-proxy -- list-rules > docs/docs/default-rules/catalog.md -->

Every built-in regex pattern (32) and the decision the native policy engine makes when it matches, in enforce mode. Each decision is computed by running a finding shaped like the detector's through the engine; nothing on this page is written by hand.

- **Request / MCP call** — the match is in an LLM request or in MCP tool arguments.
- **LLM response** — the match is in the model's response.
- **MCP tool result** — the match is in a tool result returned to the agent.
- **Check** — a validator that must also pass (Luhn, IBAN checksum, …), or for security patterns a keyword whose presence right after the match suppresses it.

Patterns run after normalization (NFKC, zero-width / BIDI / control characters removed) and also on decoded base64 / URL-encoded content.

| Condition | Decision |
|---|---|

| Session has read > 500 rows, seen PII, and attempts an external send | block (`session_data_exfil_v1`) |

## Patterns

### `US_SSN`

```text
\b(?!000|666|9\d{2})\d{3}-(?!00)\d{2}-(?!0000)\d{4}\b
```

### `EMAIL_ADDRESS`

```text
\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+\-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.\-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b
```

### `PHONE_NUMBER`

```text
(?<!\d)(?:\+1[\s.\-]?\(?\d{3}\)?[\s.\-]?\d{3}[\s.\-]?\d{4}|(?:1[\s.\-])?\(?\d{3}\)?[\s.\-]\d{3}[\s.\-]?\d{4}|\(\d{3}\)\d{3}[\s.\-]?\d{4})(?!\d)
```

### `CREDIT_CARD`

```text
\b(?:4[0-9]{12}(?:[0-9]{3})?|5[1-5][0-9]{14}|3[47][0-9]{13}|6(?:011|5[0-9]{2})[0-9]{12})\b
```

### `IBAN_CODE`

```text
\b[A-Z]{2}\d{2}[A-Z0-9]{1,30}\b
```

### `IP_ADDRESS_V4`

```text
\b(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|[01]?\d\d?)(?:\.(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|[01]?\d\d?)){3}\b
```

### `IP_ADDRESS_V6`

```text
(?i)(?:[0-9a-f]{1,4}:){7}[0-9a-f]{1,4}|(?:[0-9a-f]{1,4}:){1,7}:|(?:[0-9a-f]{1,4}:){1,6}:[0-9a-f]{1,4}|(?:[0-9a-f]{1,4}:){1,5}(?::[0-9a-f]{1,4}){1,2}|(?:[0-9a-f]{1,4}:){1,4}(?::[0-9a-f]{1,4}){1,3}|(?:[0-9a-f]{1,4}:){1,3}(?::[0-9a-f]{1,4}){1,4}|(?:[0-9a-f]{1,4}:){1,2}(?::[0-9a-f]{1,4}){1,5}|[0-9a-f]{1,4}:(?::[0-9a-f]{1,4}){1,6}|:(?::[0-9a-f]{1,4}){1,7}|::
```

### `PROMPT_INJECTION`

```text
(?i)(?:\bjailbreak\b|ignore\s+(?:previous|prior|above|all\s+previous)\s+instructions?|disregard\s+(?:all\s+)?(?:previous\s+)?instructions?|do\s+anything\s+now|DAN\s+mode|you\s+are\s+now\s+(?:free|unlocked|unrestricted)|act\s+as\s+(?:if\s+you\s+have\s+no\s+restrictions?|DAN))
```

### `SYSTEM_PROMPT_EXTRACTION`

```text
(?i)(?:reveal\s+(?:your\s+)?system\s+prompt|what\s+are\s+your\s+(?:system\s+)?instructions?|print\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:initial\s+)?(?:system\s+)?prompt|show\s+(?:me\s+)?your\s+(?:system\s+)?instructions?|repeat\s+(?:your\s+)?system\s+prompt)
```

### `MASS_DELETE`

```text
(?i)\bDELETE\s+FROM\s+\w+\s*(?:;|$)
```
